releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.138:
- CATEGORY TABS RESTORED IN PRODUCT INVENTORY: Restored dynamic department & category tabs bar (ALL, COMIDA, DRINKS, PAN, POSTRES, STORE, SIDES) in Product Inventory with one-tap filtering.
- ALL PRODUCTS VISIBLE UNDER CATEGORIES: Removed subcategory suppression in inventory table so all products belonging to a department remain clearly visible.
- MODIFIERS MIRROR IN IMPOSSIBLE MATRIX: Shifted product details to the left and placed modifier groups (Carnes, NO exclusions, Extras) side-by-side as editable columns mirroring the cashier ordering screen.
- SAVE BUTTONS IN HEADER & FOOTER: Added prominent SAVE buttons allowing immediate saving of product details and modifier options with instant database sync.
- NAVIGATION PRESERVATION: Closing Impossible Matrix or product quick editor returns directly to the Product Inventory tab without kicking the user to the main menu.
- 100% Quality Standard: 0 errors and 0 warnings verified across all integrity auditors.
